=== TOCSIN REPOSITORY SNAPSHOT FOR AI AGENTS ===
Tocsin is a real-time voice AI disaster-coordination platform that listens to fragmented multilingual voice streams, maintains live incident state, calls verified emergency tools, and coordinates response teams.

Project Structure:
- backend/: Python FastAPI application with async WebSockets, Gemini Live / LLM agentic dispatchers, emergency state machine, Redis & Agora RTC audio ingestion.
- frontend/: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, Web VAD (@ricky0123/vad-web), Agora Web SDK, voice-test and incident command center.
- mock-services/: FastAPI mock services simulating 911 dispatch, hospital bed systems, telemetry, and external emergency APIs.
- docker-compose.yml, start.sh, stop.sh: Complete local orchestration stack.
